topic: Review the research evidence on the effectiveness of generative artificial intelligence tools for improving mathematics achievement among middle school students. Assess a variety of GenAI tools (no restriction), with attention to outcome measures such as standardized test scores, grades, or other performance indicators, and the context of application (classroom, tutoring, homework, etc.). Prioritize evidence from comparative studies, meta-analyses, or experimental research published in peer-reviewed journals. Report any differences in effectiveness across settings or types of tools if available, and provide links to prominent reviews or rigorous studies.
